watch.name: tax-loop-closed
watch.nl_query: Ping me when my tax-return open loop gets closed — done or dismissed.

nodes.comment: Loop ids are resolved at compile time by lexical loop search, the same trade-off as person ids.

nodes.query: SELECT ($n.tax_loop_update.new_state IN ('done','dismissed') AND $n.tax_loop_update.old_state NOT IN ('done','dismissed')) AS fires
